items.name: valid_backend
items.source:
fn valid_backend(value: &str) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty()
        && value.len() <= 128
        && value
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'.' | b'_' | b'-'))
}

items.name: relay_connection
items.source:
async fn relay_connection(
    client: TcpStream,
    state: &Path,
    backend_port: u16,
    connections: Arc<Mutex<Connections>>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    relay_connection_with_connector(
        client,
        state,
        backend_port,
        connections,
        |backend, port| async move { TcpStream::connect((backend, port)).await },
    )
    .await
}
